import.instructions: Create up to 100 users per batch using the UTF-8 CSV template. Only username, name, and initial password are required. Department, manager, and roles are optional; leave them empty and assign departments and roles in bulk after importing. Validate before submitting. postName matches an enabled post by name. Any invalid row blocks the entire batch; import does not apply post default roles.
import.fileHint: UTF-8 CSV, up to 1 MiB / 100 rows
import.valid: {{count}} rows validated. No accounts written yet.
import.invalid: {{count}} rows. Correct these issues and upload again.
import.invalidCsv: Invalid CSV structure, template columns or row count.
import.fileTooLarge: File must be at most 1 MiB.
import.previewFailed: Validation failed. Check the file or connection and retry.
import.submitFailed: Import failed or the result is unconfirmed. Refresh the user list before validating again.

validation.tooSmall: The value is too short. Complete it according to the template.
validation.tooBig: The value is too long or contains too many items. Reduce it and validate again.
validation.invalidType: The value has the wrong type. Use text or the option required by the template.
validation.invalidFormat: The format is invalid. Check the email, date, or other value format.
validation.invalidValue: This value does not meet the requirements. Correct it using the template.
validation.unknownFields: Unsupported fields were included. Use the downloaded template.
validation.duplicateInFile: This value is duplicated in the file. Keep one record or change the value before uploading again.
validation.alreadyUsed: This value is already in use. Choose another; imports create users and do not update existing accounts.
validation.referenceUnavailable: The related record does not exist, is disabled, or is not visible. Verify it; this field is optional and can be left empty.
validation.referenceFormat: The reference format is invalid. This field is optional; you can leave it empty and assign it after importing.
validation.managerSelf: A user cannot be their own manager.
validation.permissionDenied: Your authorization scope does not allow this setting. Ask an administrator to verify your access before assigning related records.
validation.unknown: This value did not pass validation. Contact an administrator and provide the technical details below.
validation.passwordTooSmall: The password is too short. Enter an initial password of at least 8 characters.
validation.required: This field is required. Fill it in and validate again.
validation.timeFormat: Include a time zone, for example 2026-09-05T00:00:00Z. Leave empty for no activation time restriction.
validation.employmentStatus: Use probation, active, or left. Leave empty if not set.
validation.gender: Use male, female, or other. Leave empty if not set.
validation.boolean: Use true or false. Leave empty to use the template default.

aside.changesNote: The summary compares the initial values with the current ones so you can self-check before submitting. If saving fails or the result is unconfirmed, your input is kept; check the latest data before resubmitting.
aside.previewNote: The preview only reflects the current input and is not saved. After saving you land on the user's detail page, where activation and password can be set.

form.conflict: This record was updated elsewhere. Reload before saving; reloading discards your draft and needs a second confirmation.
